test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements correctly defines oligopoly?

options.text: If the market of a particular commodity consists of more than one seller, but the number of sellers is few, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.
If the market of a particular commodity consists of just one seller but the number of customers is very high, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.
If the market of a particular commodity consists of more than one seller but the number of sellers is very high, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.
If the market of a particular commodity consists of just one seller and the number of customers is few, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.

solution:
The correct answer is __**If the market of a particular commodity consists of more than one seller, but the number of sellers is few, the market structure has termed an oligopoly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A market with an oligopoly **has a small number of businesses that are aware of their interdependence **in terms of price and production strategies.**
 
• Each company has a certain amount of market power due to the small number of enterprises.
 
• Oligopoly differs from perfect competition in that each firm must consider its **interconnectedness, from monopolistic competition in that firms have some control over pricing, and from monopoly, in that, a monopolist has no competitors.**
 
• The implications of mutual dependency among firms in pricing and output decisions are** generally the focus of oligopoly study.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A market with a monopoly **has just one producer, **a duopoly has two businesses, and an oligopoly has three or more businesses.**
 
• A monopoly is a market system where there is only one seller and there are enough barriers to entry for any other sellers.
